description: Visits to each of your RankControl articles for the last 7, 30 or 90 days (default 30), from RankControl's own page analytics, most page views first: contentPageId, title, slug, pageViews, uniqueVisitors, avgTimeOnPage (seconds) and avgScrollDepth (percent of the page scrolled). Only articles with visits are listed. Null, with a hint, until the Analytics screen is turned on (activate_analytics_screen). For the whole site's top pages from Google Analytics, use get_traffic_overview with scope "site".
name: get_traffic_pages
